_meta.note: SYNTHETIC — illustrative books built for the 13F option-notional measurement (scripts/measure_13f_option_notional.py). NOT any real filer's 13F: the CIKs, CUSIPs (SYN…), accessions, prices and values are invented. Row SHAPE follows FMP's institutional-ownership/extract (see tests/fixtures/trillion_club/), and an option row carries the underlying's CUSIP, share count and notional value with putCallShare Put/Call, as a 13F information table does.

archetypes.S1: a small share book next to large put/call notional
archetypes.S2: a market-maker / multi-manager book: index ETF options dwarf the stock book; per-manager rows
archetypes.S3: a stock-picker with modest calls on held names and one index put
archetypes.S4: no options: a restating 13F-HR/A returned beside its original
archetypes.S5: no share position at all: options and a convertible (PRN) only
